groups.title: Corner grinding machines · value line
groups.lead: Belt machines that grind and polish the corner weld seams and R corners of square boxes — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: NovoTech's value line, built in China, adds the YQ corner grinding machines: horizontal machines for box edges up to 35.4, 47.2 or 59.1″ long and the YQ-450 vertical machine for corners up to 17.7″ high.
points_add: NovoTech value line: YQ horizontal corner grinders for edges to 59.1″ and the YQ-450 vertical corner grinder

faq_add.a: The GECAM 131, 136 and 135 are built in Parma, Italy, for daily production on boxes, cabinets and doors, with an oscillating belt fork for radii and the automatic head travel of the 135. The value-line YQ machines, built in China, are the lower-cost choice for corner weld seams and R corners on water tanks, battery boxes and similar boxes — horizontal for edges up to 59.1″, vertical for corners up to 17.7″ high.

set.hero_brand_line: GECAM corner grinders are designed and built in Parma, Italy; NovoTech's value-line corner grinders are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
